- **Story:** As Dana, I want my specs in .avowry files, so that the file name matches the product.
- **Acceptance criteria (Given/When/Then; at most 3, each failing on partial work):**
  1. Given an .avowry source, When avowry build runs, Then it builds as the .phrase source did, and any other extension is rejected with an error that names .avowry (there are no users yet, so the old extension is not read)
  2. Given the repository's own sources (the Tasks demo, the fixture corpus, the inline and file sources used by tests, the scripts and the orders file), When the card is merged, Then every one is renamed with git mv to .avowry in the same commit, the paths that mention them are updated, the orders hash is re-recorded (ratified in the card 162 re-freeze), and no test is removed
  3. Given the gate and CI, When the card is merged, Then both are green and the generated C# is byte-identical

## Context

- Decided by D125 and D127 (no backward compatibility: no users yet, so nothing reads or migrates .phrase). Decided by D125: .avowry (clear, unique, no known collision; .av and .avw collide with other file types). Register the editor language id as avowry in the guide, not in code. Follow docs/CODING_GUIDELINES.md; stay green at every step; keep the change small enough to revert alone; nothing is published.
